_readme: Paper-trading rules. Every bet must pass every gate. Change numbers here, not in code.

market_filters._markets_per_source: Raised from 60 on 2026-10-01 (Joey wants many more bets; BACKLOG B16): more markets reach the free filters and Jev each cycle
market_filters._min_hours_before_start: A match with a known start (Polymarket sports) is skipped from an hour before it starts, so nothing is judged in play; its result is checked from 3 hours after the start instead of a week later at the listed close
market_filters._rejudge: Trading runs hourly. A market is researched and judged again after 6 hours, or sooner if its price moves 5+ points. The price only triggers a new look; forecasters never see it.

gates._min_edge: Jev's probability must beat the cost of the contract (including fees) by at least this much
gates._min_info_sufficient: Skip markets that depend on recent news Jev hasn't been given
gates._max_framing_gap: Skip when Jev's YES and NO answers disagree: p_yes + p_no should be close to 1

research._readme: Claude Code researches events on Joey's Claude Max plan, never an API key (the code refuses to run if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set). It shares the plan's usage limits with Joey's own Claude use, so research is rationed and pauses before the plan gets busy.
research._triage_min_rules_clear: Only events where Jev rates the rules clear get researched: research can't unlock a bet on vague rules
research._research_after_hours: An event's research is reused for 24 hours, or redone sooner if a price moves 10+ points
research._week_pace_margin: 2026-10-01, Joey wants much more volume: research 60 -> 150 a day, 6 -> 10 a cycle. To keep it from filling Joey's week, research waits while the plan's weekly meter is more than 15 points ahead of an even pace through the week (news.ClaudeCode.usage_ok). The daily review and the coach are exempt
research._max_research_per_day: Raised from 20 on 2026-09-28: 20 ran out by 5 AM ET both days, leaving the rest of the day with no new research. A research run costs a median $0.28 API-equivalent, on the plan
research._pace_through_day: The day's research is spread over the UTC day (by hour h, at most per_day x (h+1)/24 used), so it never runs out by morning; per-cycle 6 only lets a cycle catch up after a gap. 'soonest' researches the events decided soonest first, so results come back sooner
research._max_week_used: Joey lifted the 85% weekly pause on 2026-09-27: research runs until the plan itself says the week is full. It still pauses when the 5-hour window is 70% used, so Joey's own sessions keep room
research._max_minutes_per_cycle: No new research or Claude direct call starts after this many minutes of a cycle, and a call is cut at 300 s (the longest measured was 73 s), so stalled calls can't push the job past GitHub's 55-minute limit

review._readme: The feedback loop. Every resolved market is scored; main's losing bets and confident misses get a Claude post-mortem (on the plan). Reviews feed the daily review (learning), which may change any strategy's betting rules by itself.

learning._readme: The self-improvement loop (docs/LEARNING.md). Automatic: scoring, reviews of misses and wins, the research playbook, the calibration map, challengers, and betting rules. Joey, 2026-09-28: the daily review may change any strategy's rules by itself (gates, bet size, open-bet limit, market filters), main included, within bounds; only frozen_strategies never change. It can never change code, fees, the price screen, research budgets, market data or settlement: a code idea waits for Joey to approve or reject it.
learning._win_margin: A resolved market gets a 'why were we right' review when main won money, or Jev with research beat the market's error by at least this much
learning._calibration_min_resolved: Was 30 until 2026-10-09; report 13 (docs/research/13-judging-skill.md) found a map fitted on tens of markets is noise
learning._calibration_prior: How strongly the calibration map is pulled toward 'Jev is already calibrated', so a handful of results can't swing it
learning._coach: The coach rewrites the research playbook once at least this many new reviews with a written post-mortem have come in, at most once a day
learning._retro: The review runs daily (was weekly until 2026-09-28) once 10 markets have been reviewed, and files at most 4 proposals: rule changes, challengers, retiring a challenger, code ideas for Joey
learning._auto_tune: Joey, 2026-09-28: a proposed rule change to any strategy but a frozen one applies by itself. With this off it waits for `approve`
learning._min_days_between_changes: A strategy's rules change at most once every 7 days (1 from 2026-09-28; 7 since 2026-10-09, docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md phase 1). Report 13 found 18 changes in 11 days, each version judged on a median of 8 settled bets: tuning on noise
learning._frozen_strategies: Never tuned: the yardstick the tuning is judged against
learning._bounds: The rules the loop may set (learn.RULES, plus skip_categories) and their ranges. From 2026-09-28 each rule's whole sensible range (Joey: 'whatever bet size', 'the limit is open'); since 2026-10-09 (docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md phase 1, Joey's blessing to carry out the plan) sizing is capped at kelly 0.5, 3% a bet and 50% open, from report 12 (docs/research/12-bet-sizing.md): above those a -30% drawdown becomes likely even with a real edge. min_edge stays at 0 or more, so no bet is placed that its own forecast says loses money; sizing keeps a small floor, so a change can't quietly stop a strategy betting (to stop one, raise its edge bar). Fees, slippage, the price screen and research budgets are not rules and can't be changed by the loop

site._readme: The public page (Cloudflare Worker jev-paper-trader, see wrangler.jsonc). Set repo_url only if the GitHub repo is public, so the page's link to the full history works for friends.

strategies._readme: Each strategy trades its own fake $100k on the same markets. They differ in the probability source and in their rules: these are the starting rules (gate_overrides), and the daily review tunes any strategy's rules from there (papertrade_data/rules.json), except 'original'. main is the headline.

main.label: Jev + Claude research
main.blurb: Jev reads Claude's research. The main test; the daily review tunes its rules as results come in.

jev_alone.label: Jev alone
jev_alone.blurb: Jev with no research at all. Retired 2026-10-10: on 1,006 finished markets it scored like a coin flip, and it placed one bet in two weeks. Its record stays here and its open bet still settles.
jev_alone._retired: docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md and research report 14: Jev isn't built for world forecasting; 'does research help Jev?' is answered by the Forecasters panel. Its colour went to the sharp-line strategy. engine.strategies leaves a retired strategy out of betting; all_books still settles its ledger

claude_direct.label: Claude direct
claude_direct.blurb: Claude reads the same research and makes its own call. Does Jev add anything?

bold.label: Jev + research, bold
bold.desc: also bets when Jev is unsure
bold.blurb: Jev + Claude, but it bets even when Jev says it's short on information.
bold._why: Joey approved 2026-09-27: main but with the info bar at 0.2 instead of 0.5, to test whether the info gate is too cautious

calibrated.label: Jev + research, self-calibrating
calibrated.blurb: Jev + Claude, with Jev's numbers corrected by what past results taught it. Starts after 30 results.
calibrated._why: Main's gates, but the probability is corrected by a map learned from every resolved market (learn.calibration_map). Waits until learning.calibration_min_resolved markets have resolved

jev_alone_bold.label: Jev alone, bold
jev_alone_bold._retired: 2026-10-10: its forecaster (Jev alone) scores like a coin flip on 1,006 markets with a real price (0.247) and adds nothing to the price (weight -0.30, range -0.63 to 0.07). Its colour went to the mention strategy; its ledger still settles
jev_alone_bold.blurb: Jev with no research and Bold's lower info bar. Retired 2026-10-10: its forecaster scores like a coin flip. Its record stays here and its open bets still settle.
jev_alone_bold._why: Joey asked for more action (2026-09-28: 'it can't self-improve if it's incredibly cautious'). Jev alone's gates with the info bar at 0.2, as Bold has; it differs from Bold only in having no research

original.label: Jev + research, original rules
original.blurb: Jev + Claude on the rules main started with, never changed. Compared with main's bets from the day it started: if main does better on those, the tuning is paying.
original._why: Joey let the daily review tune any strategy's rules (2026-09-28). This copy of main's starting rules is frozen (learning.frozen_strategies), so the tuning is judged against leaving the rules alone

sharp.label: Sharp line (Pinnacle)
sharp.desc: buys below the sharp sportsbook price
sharp.blurb: No AI forecast: on games, it buys a Kalshi or Polymarket side priced at least 3¢ below Pinnacle's odds with the bookmaker's margin taken out. Pinnacle is the sportsbook professional bettors measure themselves against.
sharp._why: docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md phase 2A, research report 09 (2026-10-10, Joey: 'do what you need to fix this'). The fair price comes from The Odds API (papertrade/odds.py, ODDS_API_KEY); it never reaches Jev or Claude. Sized like every strategy by measured skill: probes until its edge over the venue price shows on 300+ markets

mention_no.label: Mention markets, NO side
mention_no.desc: bets against YES optimism in 'will X say Y'
mention_no.blurb: No AI forecast: in Kalshi markets on whether someone will say a word (earnings calls, interviews), it buys NO at 30-70c before the event. On 639 settled ones, NO there won 62% against the 49% its price implied: +21% after fees.
mention_no._why: Research report 15 (Bartlett & O'Hara 2026: YES at 50c settled YES about 40% across 35,000+ Kalshi mention markets), replicated on 639 settled Kalshi mention markets on 2026-10-10 at the first real taker price before the event: NO at 30-70c +21.0% after the taker fee, 95% range +6.1% to +35.5% over 55 events (docs/research/CHECKS.md). Found on history, so it must now pass a forward test (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md). Sized by measured skill: probes until its edge shows on 300+ markets; never more contracts than the ask offers

mention._readme: The mention strategy's prior (engine.mention_prior): inside the band of YES mids, P(YES) = mid - yes_bias, from the 2026-10-10 replication (NO at 30-70c won 61.7% vs 49.3% implied; YES at 50-90c lost 14-22%). Markets are those markets.fetch_kalshi's walk sees with MENTION in the ticker, looked at once per market_filters.rejudge_after_hours and only more than min_hours_before their expected end
mention._pace: 2026-10-10, Joey: check more often. A mention market is looked at again every hour (prices drift into the band), and the strategy may place up to 15 probes a day, at most one per event, so its forward test finishes about three times sooner

sharp._readme: The sharp-line strategy's data (papertrade/odds.py). The Odds API returns Pinnacle's and the venues' head-to-head prices per game; each listed sport is refreshed at most every refresh_minutes and not once the quota left falls to reserve. A line older than max_line_age_minutes, or with a margin above max_margin, is not used. A Kalshi game market matches when it names both teams and is decided within kickoff_window_hours of the start; a Polymarket market when it names one team and starts within that window or carries the game's date. Set for The Odds API's free tier: 4 sports x 3 a day is about 12 requests a day, inside the 391 left on 2026-10-10 after a test run spent about 100 by mistake (tests can no longer call it). With a paid plan, lower refresh_minutes

storage._readme: judgments.jsonl and research.jsonl move into papertrade_data/archive/ (gzipped) once past this size; every reader still reads the archives. GitHub refuses files over 100 MB

sizing._readme: The starting sizing for every strategy: quarter-Kelly, capped at 2% of equity per bet and 50% of equity in open bets overall (Joey raised it from 30% on 2026-09-28). The daily review may change all three per strategy (learning.bounds)

fees._polymarket: Polymarket takers pay rate x p x (1 - p) per share, the rate set per market (crypto 0.07; sports, economics, culture, weather 0.05; politics, finance, tech, mentions 0.04; geopolitics 0; docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees, read 2026-10-09). Each market's own rate comes from its feeSchedule; one that doesn't publish a rate pays the default. Before 2026-10-09 the trader charged 0 here (BACKLOG B26)

skill._readme: docs/REBUILD_PLAN.md phase 1 (2026-10-09, after the research in docs/research/). Every strategy but the frozen yardstick sizes its bets by its forecaster's measured edge over the market price, lambda (engine.skill), from finished markets with a real price. While lambda is 0 (every forecaster on 2026-10-09) a strategy places probe bets: probe_stake_pct of equity, at most max_probes_per_day a day. Once lambda is positive on min_markets markets, Kelly on the forecast shrunk toward the market, scaled down as equity nears drawdown_floor of its peak. All open bets in one event share one max_stake_pct budget. Not a rule the daily review may tune
